prompt: What was David Fincher's most recently released feature film when Britney Spears' first feature film was released in the U.S.?
answer: Britney Spears’ first feature film, **_Crossroads_**, was released in the U.S. on **February 15, 2002**. At that point, David Fincher’s most recently released feature was **_Fight Club_ (1999)**—his next film, **_Panic Room_**, did not arrive until March 2002.
